OpenElixir-02 1.4, custom firmware for the Erica Synths LXR-02 drum machine: a reworked **song page**,
**repeats in songs** and reliable **pattern names**. It builds on 1.3.

> Tested on hardware by the author. OpenElixir-02 is not official Erica Synths firmware and is not
> affiliated with or approved by Erica Synths. Install it at your own risk.

## Song page

The song page (SONG) shows two rows, the cursor slot and the one after it:

```
>[01] Groove1  ↑     cursor row: the encoder moves the cursor
>p03 [Groove1 ]↑     after an encoder press: the encoder changes the entry
*[03] Break    ↓     the slot the song is playing
```

- Slots are numbered 1-64, followed by the pattern's name ("Pat 05" if it has none), END or LOOP.
- `>` marks the cursor, `*` the slot the song is playing (while it plays).
- While choosing a slot's pattern, the brackets move to the name and the number on the left shows the
  pattern (`p03`; `p--` for END, LOOP and REP).
- A pattern actually named "END" or "LOOP" shows in apostrophes (`'END'`), so it can't be mistaken for
  the song marks.
- The page follows the song as it plays.
- SHIFT + PLAY always starts the song at slot 1. Before, the page could show position 255, and a
  pattern change that was still waiting played before the song.

## Repeats in songs

After LOOP, the entries `REP x01` to `REP x32` follow when choosing a slot's entry. `REP xNN` plays the
pattern before it NN more times, then the song continues:

```
01 Intro
02 Verse
03 REP x03     Verse plays 4 times in total
04 Chorus
05 LOOP        back to 01
```

- While repeating, the song page stays on the REP row.
- Consecutive REPs add up; a REP with no pattern before it (slot 1, after END or LOOP) is skipped.
- LOOP is unchanged: it jumps back to slot 1.
- Songs keep one byte per slot. The stock firmware ends a song at a REP entry.

## Pattern names

The stock firmware never let you name patterns, but it wrote whatever was in its name buffer into the
pattern files, so old files often contain leftover text in their name field. Now a name is shown only
if it was given in the pattern save dialog: on the pattern pages, on the song page and in the pattern
lists of other projects. Otherwise the pattern shows as "Pat 05" (a slot without steps as "Empty" on
the pattern pages).

- The flag is saved in the pattern file. Stock firmware and 1.3 read these files as before.
- Patterns already named with the 1.3 save dialog show "Pat 05" until they are saved once more.

## Also included

Everything from 1.3: the step arp, faster knobs (SHIFT + knob), LFO targets for the whole unit (`Prf`),
the pattern pages with names and patterns from other projects, kits and patterns from other projects
that stay temporary until saved, and all earlier features. Details:
[README](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/blob/v1.4/README.md) and the
[1.3 release notes](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/releases/tag/v1.3).

## Installing

1. Download `LXR_OpenElixir-02_V1.4.img` below.
2. Copy it to the top folder of the SD card and delete any other `LXR*.img` files there.
3. Switch the LXR-02 off, insert the card, hold the encoder button and switch it on. Keep holding
   until "LXR Updater" appears.
4. Wait for "Update OK!". The device restarts with the new firmware.

To go back, install the official firmware update from Erica Synths the same way. Kits, patterns and
songs saved with OpenElixir-02 keep working there: slots with a different engine play with their stock
engine, arp steps play as flams, `Prf` LFOs are off and songs end at a REP entry.

The `.hex` and `.elf` files are for programming and debugging with an ST-Link; you don't need them for
a normal update.
